title: AI session about tickets
what: Ask the AI about one or more tickets (up to 40): it reads descriptions and comments and answers; the answer streams in, you can keep asking, and ticket IDs in the answer are clickable.

how.t: Click "Tickets"
Click a ticket row (click the title) to open the side panel
Click ✨ "AI for this ticket"
Type a request in the box below, Enter to send (Shift+Enter for a new line)
how.at: Yêu cầu cho AI về các ticket đã chọn

how.t: Add tickets: type numbers or IDs in the "Add 123, 456" box (several separated by commas), then Enter
how.at: Thêm ticket: số hoặc ID, nhiều cái cách dấu phẩy, Enter

how.t: Click "New chat" to start over (or "Cancel" to stop, "Copy" to copy)

keys: ai session ask ai chat ai keep asking new chat add ticket

area: Side panel › AI session › Suggestion buttons
title: Ready-made prompts in the AI session
what: Ready-made AI job buttons: Thread summary, Check AC coverage, Split tasks & estimate, Tidy up description, Test cases, Draft reply (1 ticket); Summary & to-dos, Review for lead, Release notes (several tickets). Each role has 4 default buttons.

how.t: Click "Tickets"
Click a ticket row (click the title) to open the side panel
Click ✨ "AI for this ticket"
Click a suggestion button (hover for a description), e.g. "Thread summary"

how: Buttons that need exactly 1 ticket or 2+ tickets tell you in a notice
keys: ready-made prompts summarize thread check ac split tasks estimate tidy up description test cases draft reply review for lead release notes

title: Put the AI's answer into a comment
what: In an AI session about 1 ticket, put the answer (or a draft, e.g. Draft reply) into the ticket's comment box to edit and post to YouTrack.

how.t: Click "Tickets"
Click a ticket row (click the title) to open the side panel
Click ✨ "AI for this ticket"
Ask the AI (e.g. click "Compose reply") and wait for it to finish
Click "Use as comment"
Edit it, then click "Send comment"

keys: put in comment ai answer draft comment

area: Side panel › AI session › Code folder
title: Trace code in the project folder (Dev)
what: Dev role only (QA / PO: the AI reads tickets only). Choose a project folder so the AI reads the code when answering. Turn on "Run commands" to let the AI build / test / run gradle in a sandbox (writes only inside that folder, network only to package registries, no code edits). The Dev role can hand a free-form question to the AI Agent to trace the code, choosing "Analyze only" or "Allow code edits".

how.t: Click "Tickets"
Click a ticket row (click the title) to open the side panel
Click ✨ "AI for this ticket"
Pick a folder in the project box (like the Telegram tab; "Add folder…" to add one, "Don't read code" to drop it)
how.at: Dự án tham chiếu cho AI

how.t: For the AI to build / test / run gradle: click "Run commands"
Dev: choose the "Mode" (Analyze only / Allow code edits)
Type a request in the box
how.at: Yêu cầu cho AI về các ticket đã chọn

how.t: Click "Assign … trace code"

keys: run commands build gradle shell test sandbox trace code read code project folder ai agent edit code analyze only codebase

area: Side panel › AI session › Prompt library
title: Prompt library (add, edit, pin, delete)
what: A prompt library shared by the whole team: run, add new prompts, edit, delete, pin up to 5 prompts as buttons per role and ticket count; restore deleted built-in prompts. Also in Settings › YouTrack.

how.t: Click "Tickets"
Click a ticket row (click the title) to open the side panel
Click ✨ "AI for this ticket"
Click "Prompt library"
Click "New prompt", enter the "Prompt name" and "Prompt text"
Click "Save"
Click the pin icon to pin/unpin (up to 5)
Click the ▶ icon to run it right away

keys: prompt library new prompt pin edit prompt delete prompt restore defaults

title: AI instructions per role
what: Your team's own instructions for the selected role, which the AI follows in every YouTrack feature (except ticket filtering). AI sessions show an "Instructions Dev/QC/PO" label when there are some.

how.t: Click the "Settings" icon at the right of the top bar
Choose the "YouTrack" section
Choose "AI and prompts"
Enter instructions in the "AI instructions" box
Click "Save"

how: In an AI session, hover the "Instructions …" label to see them
keys: instructions ai guidance team notes rules
